thread:
Maya (CS): Quick sync from today's NorthBay kickoff. They surfaced three things: (1) embeddings not reflecting recent re-index for hours, (2) lack of a simple per-route billing toggle for customers, (3) token usage export is awkward for their finance team.
Arjun (Product): Can you paste their exact asks / repro notes?
Maya (CS): Pasted from call notes: - Auto-refresh embeddings or a signal when offline re-index completes (they rerun embeddings nightly and expect app to pick them up quickly). - Console toggle to enable/disable billing for individual ingestion routes. - In-product admin view for per-route token consumption (CSV export is painful).
Evan (PM): Which of these are blocking the renewal/pilot?
Maya (CS): Embedding staleness + billing toggle = renewal risk. Token export = usability annoyance.
Priya (CS): Additional detail: during a demo they hit duplicated vectors after a re-index while the app queried mid-process. Demo failed, customer flagged reliability concerns.
Ben (Eng): Repro steps useful. Maya can you share what they did that created duplicates?
Maya (CS): Steps they shared: 1) upload new batch -> 2) background re-index job starts -> 3) frontend issues lookup while index streaming -> duplicates appear in results. They reproduced consistently.
Arjun (Product): Proposed triage: Short-term: show indexing status in UI + block queries until index completes (fast). Mid-term: implement atomic swap on index namespaces (safer). Billing toggle: add per-tenant feature flag + console control.
Evan (PM): Prioritize embed fix and billing toggle as P1 because NorthBay renewal is pending. Token export = P2.
Priya (CS): I'll draft an interim customer-facing note explaining the workaround and the planned timeline.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-13872 assigned to @Arjun.
Arjun (Product): @Ben do you have rough engineering estimates for the quick UI/status patch vs atomic swap?
Ben (Eng): UI/status + debounce: ~1-3 days including QA. Atomic swap & infra changes: ~3-5 weeks. Billing toggle + console control: ~2-4 days.
Evan (PM): Plan: ship UI/status patch + billing toggle in next sprint, communicate to NorthBay, schedule atomic swap for next quarter. Maya/Priya coordinate comms and demo.
Maya (CS): I'll send the customer note and propose two demo times.
Priya (CS): I'll follow up and confirm pilot renewal cadence with their finance lead.
Arjun (Product): I'll open RFC for atomic swap and link this thread. Ben please paste ticket numbers when ready and cc eng-oncall if pipeline touches scheduling.
Ben (Eng): Will add tickets and tag oncall.
Maya (CS): Draft of customer message: "We understand the impact on your pilot. We're prioritizing fixes that directly affect your renewal: we'll ship a UI status + debounce within 10 business days and a billing toggle within two weeks; longer-term consistency (atomic swap) is scoped for Q3. We'll schedule a short demo once the patch is live."
Evan (PM): Good — add the prioritization criteria (user impact, effort, cross-customer demand, security/regulatory). Keep it concise.
Maya (CS): Added and sending now. Thanks team :thumbsup:
